intro.uz: Bu — Nilufar va sinfdoshi Bekzod oʻrtasidagi suhbat. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz ertalab birinchi boʻlib nima qilasiz?

paragraphs.en: Nilufar: Bekzod, you always come to class first, and you never look tired. What time do you get up? Bekzod: I usually get up at half past five. Last year I used to sleep until seven, but I changed my habits.
paragraphs.uz: Nilufar: Bekzod, sen doim sinfga birinchi kelasan va hech qachon charchagan koʻrinmaysan. Soat nechada turasan? Bekzod: Odatda besh yarimda turaman. Oʻtgan yili yettigacha uxlardim, lekin odatlarimni oʻzgartirdim.

paragraphs.en: Nilufar: Half past five! That's really early. What do you do first? Bekzod: First I drink a glass of water. Then I go running in the park near our house for twenty minutes. My dad comes with me on Saturdays.
paragraphs.uz: Nilufar: Besh yarimda! Bu juda erta-ku. Birinchi nima qilasan? Bekzod: Avval bir stakan suv ichaman. Keyin uyimiz yaqinidagi bogʻda yigirma daqiqa yuguraman. Shanba kunlari dadam ham men bilan boradi.

paragraphs.en: Nilufar: And what do you have for breakfast? Bekzod: My mum makes tea, and we eat bread, eggs and some fruit together. I don't look at my phone at breakfast. I think breakfast is better without it.
paragraphs.uz: Nilufar: Nonushtaga nima yeysan? Bekzod: Oyim choy damlaydi, biz birga non, tuxum va biroz meva yeymiz. Nonushta paytida telefonimga qaramayman. Menimcha, nonushta telefonsiz yaxshiroq.

paragraphs.en: Nilufar: Why did you change your habits? Bekzod: Last year I was always late, and I felt tired in lessons. Our sports teacher told me to sleep earlier and move more in the morning. Now I go to bed at ten.
paragraphs.uz: Nilufar: Nega odatlaringni oʻzgartirding? Bekzod: Oʻtgan yili doim kechikardim va darslarda charchagan boʻlardim. Jismoniy tarbiya oʻqituvchimiz menga ertaroq uxlashni va ertalab koʻproq harakat qilishni maslahat berdi. Hozir soat oʻnda yotaman.

paragraphs.en: Nilufar: Is it difficult? Bekzod: It was difficult in the first week, but now it's easy. I feel healthier, and my marks are better too.
paragraphs.uz: Nilufar: Qiyinmi? Bekzod: Birinchi haftada qiyin edi, lekin hozir oson. Oʻzimni sogʻlomroq his qilyapman, baholarim ham yaxshilandi.

paragraphs.en: Nilufar: I think I'm going to try it next month! Bekzod: Great idea! We can run in the park together.
paragraphs.uz: Nilufar: Menimcha, kelasi oy men ham sinab koʻraman! Bekzod: Zoʻr fikr! Bogʻda birga yugurishimiz mumkin.
